governingRule: Only W01/Chat 1 registers numbered Drizzle migrations or exports staged DB04 modules through src/db/schema/index.ts.

candidates.feature: Private profile/document object receipt with owner, purpose, generation, digest, scan and retention metadata
candidates.decision: Private object key only; no public/presigned URL as canonical identity. Numeric object generation and 64-hex digest are DB constrained.
tests: revoked/expired/non-clean evidence not usable by producer

candidates.feature: Normalized learner education source of truth for profile verification and placement screening
candidates.decision: Preserve GPA as well as CGPA, explicit currently-pursuing state, recent-education identity, exam details and per-row archival/history surface.
tests: end year before start year rejected
archived education excluded from screening projection

candidates.decision: Use enforceable composite owner/purpose FK rather than unconstrained polymorphic relatedEntryId.
tests: education and receipt owner mismatch rejected

candidates.feature: Persisted learner profile-image collection with receipt-backed object identity and active/deactivation state
candidates.decision: Receipt alone is not equivalent to legacy student_image collection semantics; preserve image identity/order/active state without arbitrary canonical URLs.

promotionChecklist: Register receipt parent composite keys before education/image child FKs.
Deduplicate equivalent parent keys already introduced by DB01/DB08 integration.
Export the staged education/image module only in the same reviewed migration batch that creates its tables.
Generate one canonical Drizzle migration from approved schema; do not execute duplicate raw staging SQL.
Run empty-database and latest-database replay with schema/snapshot drift inspection.
Execute wrong-owner, wrong-purpose, direct-SQL and concurrency witnesses on disposable PostgreSQL.
Prove runtime profile CRUD, screening, verification and image APIs use the registered normalized source of truth.
Record explicit approval before treating either historical table as retired.
Keep DATABASE phase blocked until executed evidence exists.
